structured_output.rationale: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing expired) with N211. But the 277CA shows STC*A2:20 on 2025-07-10 — the claim was accepted by the clearinghouse 19 days after the 2025-06-21 DOS, well inside any commercial window. Payer is CI (commercial), so N211 does not invoke 42 CFR 405.926 and does not bar appeal. The CO-29 is disputable with the acceptance report.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 on both lines; payer claims filing limit expired. 277CA STC*A2:20 dated 2025-07-10 proves electronic acceptance 19 days post-DOS — within any commercial limit.

next_action.detail: File redetermination/appeal citing erroneous CO-29. Attach the 277CA (TRN TRC86768843, STC A2:20, 2025-07-10) as proof of timely receipt. N211 does not bar commercial appeals. Dispute payer's receipt date — do not plead forgiveness.

STC*A2:20*20250710 — clearinghouse accepted claim on 2025-07-10, 19 days after DOS
CO-29 with proof of accepted submission inside window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report; N211 bar applies only to Medicare FFS under 42 CFR 405.926

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside filing window → appeal; dispute receipt date with clearinghouse acceptance report
42 CFR 405.926 (N211 bar) applies only to Medicare FFS redeterminations, not commercial
